summary_1line: Kapila and Syumarasmi debate sacrifice and household duty versus renunciation and knowledge as the true path to liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kapila the sage sits calmly while instructing Syumarasmi about controlling the four doors of the body—speech, arms, stomach, and desire.
A wandering ascetic sleeps on bare earth with his arm as a pillow, clothed only in tranquility under the open sky.
Two sages face each other in earnest debate, one defending sacrificial rites while the other speaks of knowledge and renunciation.
